cause_quote: The new greeting helper hard-coded both branches: “return name ? `Hi, I’m ${name}. Happy to help.` : "Hi! Happy to help.";”
user_saw: When users created an agent with a non-English Control UI language selected, the new chat opened with an English greeting.
summary: The fix passes the selected locale through agent creation, translates the saved greeting, and instructs the agent to ask its opening role question in that language.
reasoning: The parent commit already supported non-English Control UI locales. The introducing diff added the saved onboarding greeting with English-only text and gave the model an English role question without a locale instruction. The greeting helper's path history shows that its English-only implementation persisted until this fix.
